tasks.enforce.title: How the routing is enforced
tasks.enforce.onlyOnDevice: Exact values only on this device. In a browser without Chrome’s on-device model (Safari, Firefox, Chrome without it), the Firebase AI Logic SDK would send even an ONLY_ON_DEVICE request to the cloud. So before every such call this app asks the browser for the model, and stops when it is not there.
tasks.enforce.status.downloadable: Chrome’s on-device model can be downloaded
tasks.enforce.status.unavailable: no on-device model, so tasks that use exact values do not run
tasks.enforce.monitor: A network check lets a request to Firebase AI Logic leave only when a cloud task registered it a moment before; anything else is blocked and listed in “Leaving your device”.
tasks.enforce.types: Exact values have their own type in the code, and a call that can reach the cloud does not accept it: a mistake fails to build.
